ag.area.hint: The ground within which the Explorer picks what to write about: "wine and wineries", "stories of cooks". It is not a bag of keywords like the Writer's — nothing is matched against headlines here — but a description of the territory.
ag.area.label: Area to explore
ag.costoImagen.nota: * Approximate prices in USD. The image model is set under Site Settings. Quality and these prices apply to gpt-image-* models.
ag.cuantasNotas: How many articles should it write?
ag.cuantosBorradores: How many drafts should it review and publish?
ag.director.desc: Reviews the drafts the Writers produce and publishes the final articles.
ag.director.hint: Guidelines the Director applies when reviewing and publishing drafts.
ag.director.placeholder: E.g. Make sure the headlines are compelling, the content is accurate and the writing is clean…
ag.director.vacio: No Director configured. Without one, drafts will never be published automatically.
ag.eliminar.pregunta: Are you sure you want to delete the agent
ag.estiloVisual.hint: Visual style instructions for the text model that writes the image prompt. The more specific, the more consistent the covers.
ag.estiloVisual.label: Visual style instructions
ag.estiloVisual.placeholder: E.g. Prefer printed illustrations over photographs for this beat. Muted inks on warm stock, catalogue-sheet layout. No people, no faces.
ag.etiqueta.hint: Every article this agent writes is published under this tag. The agent decides it, not the model, so the section does not depend on the AI guessing a taxonomy. Tags are created from the Content Manager.
ag.etiqueta.label: Section for its articles
ag.exigirFuentes.hint: If no news matches the topic, it writes nothing. Without sources the model writes from memory and makes facts up. Recommended for legal and health topics.
ag.exploradores.desc: They write without depending on the feeds: they pick a topic in their area, search the web and cite what they found.
ag.exploradores.vacio: No Explorer yet. Useful when your sources publish rarely, or for pieces that do not depend on the day's news.
ag.habilitado.hint: Switched off, the cron will not run it.
ag.horarios.vacio: No schedules yet. Add one so the agent runs automatically.
ag.imagen.desc: Supplies the configuration for AI covers. Without it, articles publish with no image.
ag.imagen.vacio: No Image Generator. The cover button in the Content Manager will be disabled.
ag.instrucciones.hint: What this agent does and how. It is read by the runner the project assigned to this role.
ag.instrucciones.label: Agent instructions
ag.nombre.hint: This name appears as the Author on the generated articles.
ag.nombre.label: Agent name / Author
ag.ok.ejecutado: Agent "{nombre}" ran for {n, plural, one {# note} other {# notes}}.
ag.redactor.hint: Describe the writer's voice, style and personality.
ag.redactor.placeholder: E.g. Write in the first person, in a close and explanatory tone, for readers in the sector…
ag.redactores.desc: Each Writer drafts articles on its own specific topic, with its own tone and style.
ag.redactores.vacio: No Writers configured. Add at least one to start producing articles.
ag.rol.director: The Director reviews the drafts the Writers produce and publishes them.
ag.rol.explorador: Picks a topic within its area, researches it on the web and writes from the sources it found. It does not use the RSS feeds: it is for pieces that do not depend on the day's news. Each run performs a web search, which costs more than a regular article.
ag.rol.imagen: The Image Generator supplies the configuration for AI covers.
ag.rol.redactor: The Writer drafts articles on its own topic and in its own style.
ag.rol.vacio: No agents with the {rol} role yet.
ag.subtitulo: Manage the agents that write and publish articles automatically.
ag.tema.hint: Set the subject area this writer covers. The more specific, the better.
ag.tema.label: Writer's topic
ag.tema.placeholder: Beat keywords, separated by spaces. E.g. logistics transport fleet customs warehouse
ag.trad.alDia: Every published article is already translated.
ajustes.adsense.desc: Publisher IDs and slots for the site's banners. The site reads them live.
ajustes.adsense.inarticle: Ad inserted at the end of every blog post body (mobile and desktop).
ajustes.adsense.infeed: In-feed ad that replaces the third story on the home page.
ajustes.adsense.mobile: Responsive horizontal banner, shown only on mobile and tablet (<1536px), where the sidebars are hidden.
ajustes.adsense.publisher.hint: Publisher ID from your AdSense account. Format: ca-pub-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX
ajustes.analytics.desc: GA4 plus Search Console verification. The site reads them; the GA tag is only injected in production.
ajustes.clarity.desc: Heatmaps and session recordings. The site reads it; the script is only injected in production.
ajustes.clarity.hint: Clarity project ID (clarity.microsoft.com → Settings → Overview). E.g. wzkcreip2d
ajustes.ga.hint: Measurement ID of your GA4 property. Format: G-XXXXXXXXXX (Admin → Data streams → your site).
ajustes.houseAds.hint: When on, the house ads loaded in the 'House ad' collection replace the AdSense slots one by one. Off = every slot goes back to AdSense.
ajustes.houseAds.label: Show house ads instead of AdSense
ajustes.identidad.desc: The colours and the logo the social cards and the reel overlays are drawn with. The text on the cards —the voice, the hashtags, the @handle— is configured under Editorial configuration.
ajustes.modeloDirector.hint: Checks each draft against its sources before publishing it. A more capable one rejects fewer good articles, and it runs once per draft: upgrading it costs far less than upgrading the text model.
ajustes.modeloDirector.label: Director model
ajustes.modeloImagen.hint: Model for covers. gpt-image-* / dall-e-3 use OpenAI; google/gemini-* use Nano Banana (Gemini) through OpenRouter and need OPENROUTER_API_KEY.
ajustes.modeloImagen.label: Image model
ajustes.modeloTexto.hint: Language model for writing articles, and for reviewing them unless the Director has its own.
ajustes.modeloTexto.label: Text model
ajustes.modelos.desc: API keys come from env vars: OPENAI_API_KEY (text and images), OPENAI_IMAGE_API_KEY (optional override), OPENROUTER_API_KEY (for Nano Banana / Gemini images) and OPENAI_ADMIN_KEY (optional, only to see the usage above).
ajustes.ok.logo: Logo uploaded. Save to apply it.
ajustes.publicacion.desc: What happens automatically when an article is published.
ajustes.searchConsole.hint: Search Console → 'HTML tag' method: paste ONLY the content value, not the whole tag.
ajustes.sitio.desc: Third-party services the SITE injects into its HTML. None of them is read by the CMS or changes what the agents do; all three are optional.
ajustes.subtitulo: The site's external integrations, the visual identity of the social cards and the APIs' usage. The keys live in the CMS environment, never in the database.
ajustes.tagDefecto.hint: Slug of an existing tag. It is added to notes created by hand when the editor picks none. Empty = no tag.
ajustes.tagDefecto.label: Default tag (slug)
ajustes.traducir.hint: Translates every article on publish, into the language set under Editorial configuration. On a single-language site it is worth switching off: it is one model call per article that nobody uses.
ajustes.traducir.label: Translate automatically
ajustes.uso.desc: Live data from the APIs. OpenRouter is prepaid and shows a balance; OpenAI is postpaid and only publishes consumption.
ajustes.uso.err: Could not read the APIs' usage.
ajustes.ventana.hint: How many days back the feeds are read, and how long news items are kept. Raise it if your sources publish rarely: at 7 days, a feed posting once a month never contributes. Between 1 and 90.
ajustes.ventana.label: News window (days)
audit.err.cargar: Could not load the audit log.
audit.subtitulo: A trail of every action the Directors, Writers and Image Generators run. Read only.
audit.totalPaginas: {total, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}} · page {pagina} of {paginas}
audit.vacio.desc: No actions recorded with these filters.
gen.buscar.hint: Look for sources (if the change needs new data)
gen.buscar.label: Search the web when refining
gen.guardar.nota: Save as a draft to review in the Content Manager, or publish right away (this also generates the translation).
gen.imagen.hint: Optional. Left empty, it uses the configured image agent.
gen.imagen.placeholder: Leave empty to use the agent, or describe the image…
gen.pedido.hint: Describe the article you want. E.g. 'A round-up of this week's developments and why they matter'.
gen.refinar.hint: Ask for a change. E.g. 'Make it shorter', 'Add a quote', 'Shift the angle to the impact on the reader'.
gen.refinar.label: Change instruction
gen.refinar.placeholder: What would you like to change?
gen.subtitulo: Write an article on demand from a prompt. The model searches the web for sources; you edit, refine and publish.
marca.accent.hint: The brand colour. The middle of the gradient.
marca.accent.label: Accent
marca.accentDeep.hint: The end of the gradient and the colour veils. It never carries text on top, so it can be dark.
marca.accentDeep.label: Deep accent
marca.accentLight.hint: Every accent that is text: the large numbers, the quote mark, the url.
marca.accentLight.label: Light accent
marca.bg.hint: The card background when there is no image. It also tints the veil over photos.
marca.bg.label: Background
marca.body.label: Body
marca.hexInvalido: It has to be a six-digit hex, like #1F4E63.
marca.logo.hint: PNG with a transparent background. It is printed at the foot of every card and large on the closing one. Without it the engine's logo is used.
marca.logo.label: Card logo
marca.muted.hint: The signature, the attribution and the labels.
marca.muted.label: Footer
marca.par.title: Headlines on the background
marca.preview.bajada: The standfirst takes the body colour, which carries the most text.
marca.preview.nota: A sample card in these colours. The @handle comes from Editorial configuration.
marca.title.label: Headlines
nota.aMano.desc: Open an empty form and write the article yourself.
nota.aviso.calco: The title echoes a source headline (“{titular}”). Rewrite it in your own words before creating the note.
nota.buscar.hint: Look for sources (if the change needs new data)
nota.buscar.label: Look for sources when refining
nota.conIA.desc: Write a brief and the model drafts it. Then you edit.
nota.err.faltan: The title or the body is missing.
nota.err.sinImagen: To publish, the article needs an image.
nota.estado.borrador: Draft. Save your changes; you publish from Articles whenever you like.
nota.estado.nueva: Save as a draft to review, or publish straight away.
nota.estado.publicada: The article is published: your changes go live on save.
nota.estado.sinImagen: Generate or upload an image before you can publish.
nota.imagen.hint: Optional. Left empty, the AI picks the scene with the configured agent.
nota.imagen.label: Prompt to generate (optional)
nota.imagen.placeholder: Describe the image, or leave it empty…
nota.instruccion.placeholder: What would you like the AI to change?
nota.mejorar.hint: Ask for a change to what is above. E.g. 'Shorter', 'More formal tone', 'Add a closing line'.
nota.ok.generada: Article written. Review and adjust below.
nota.pedido.hint: Describe the article you want. E.g. 'What changed in the sector this week and who it affects'.
nota.pedido.label: Brief for the AI
nota.slug.hint: Used in the article's URL. It is generated from the title; edit it if you like.
nota.sub.crear: Write an article with the AI's help, or write it yourself.
nota.sub.editar: Change the content, the tags and the image. If the article is published, your changes go live on save.
nota.tags.hint: They decide which section of the site the article appears in.
notas.borrar.pregunta: Delete «{titulo}» in every language, translations included? This cannot be undone.
notas.err.destacado: Could not change the featured flag.
notas.err.estado: Could not change the article's status.
notas.err.imagen: Could not generate the image (check the agent and the API key).
notas.err.preview: Could not open the preview (is PREVIEW_SECRET / PREVIEW_WEB_URL configured?).
notas.generandoImagen: Generating the image with the agent… it can take about 30 s.
notas.preview.nota: You're seeing the draft as the real site renders it. Changes to the site's design show up here.
notas.subtitulo: Check, edit and publish the site's articles, in chronological order.
notas.totalPaginas: {total, plural, one {# note} other {# notes}} · page {pagina} of {paginas}
panel.generandoPortada: Generating the cover in the background…
panel.portada.desc: Article cover (Director style): a prompt with memory, applied directly.
panel.sinAgente: Set up an image-generator agent to enable covers.
panel.studio.desc: Downloadable carousels, stories and reels — with an editable preview.
prompts.analysis.hint: How an article must present itself when there are NO verified news items behind it.
prompts.analysis.label: Analysis-mode framing
prompts.anchors.hint: ⚠️ Each «- key: rule» line declares a key the model is asked for. Adding or removing a line changes what gets extracted: the engine reads the keys from here, it does not have them hardcoded.
prompts.anchors.label: Anchors to extract
prompts.body.hint: The brand voice and the Markdown rules. It is the longest field and the one that most defines how the articles sound.
prompts.body.label: Voice and body format
prompts.borrador.aviso: You are looking at a draft in your own language, to read and edit. What gets sent to the model is the final text, in English: translate a field to update it, or switch to «Show the final text» to review it.
prompts.brandName.hint: The agents write under this name and the social cards are signed with it.
prompts.brandName.label: Brand name
prompts.coverStyle.hint: What the background of the first card must show. It is inserted inside the image request.
prompts.coverStyle.label: Cover image style
prompts.cta.hint: Pasted verbatim at the end of the caption. Empty = nothing is added.
prompts.cta.label: Caption sign-off
prompts.dedup.hint: Two lines: what counts as the SAME event and what doesn't, with examples from your subject. With another subject's examples, the checker merges different stories or lets repeats through.
prompts.dedup.label: De-duplication examples
prompts.domain.hint: Completes the sentence «You are a journalist writing … for '{this}'». The writer, the Director, the deduplicator and the translator all read it: say too much or too little and all four drift the same way.
prompts.domain.label: What the site covers
prompts.fabrication.hint: Comma-separated list of the data this topic tends to hallucinate: dates, figures, rulings, results.
prompts.fabrication.label: Facts that can never be invented
prompts.fallback.hint: Used when the model returns no image request of its own. Without it the cover came out black.
prompts.fallback.label: Fallback image
prompts.glossary.hint: A full prompt line. The topic's proper nouns go here: bodies, programmes, competitions, terms with no equivalent.
prompts.glossary.label: What is NOT translated
prompts.guardaCuandoQuieras: Save whenever you like — changes from every step are saved together.
prompts.guardrails.hint: Your own bullets, added to the Director's brand guardrail, each starting with “  - ”: specific outlets never to cite, third-party content never to reproduce. Empty = only the engine's rules.
prompts.guardrails.label: Extra rules for the Director
prompts.handle.hint: Without the @. It is printed at the foot of every card, large on the closing card and over videos, and closes the caption as the last hashtag. Empty = it is not printed anywhere.
prompts.handle.label: Social handle
prompts.hashtags.hint: Comma-separated. Empty = the model picks based on the article.
prompts.hashtags.label: Hashtag topics
prompts.identidad.desc: Who writes and what the site covers. It is the first thing every agent reads: the writer, the Director, the deduplicator and the translator.
prompts.imageRules.hint: What is shown, what is forbidden, how faces are avoided. The safety suffix is always appended, even if you clear this field.
prompts.imageRules.label: Image rules
prompts.linea.desc: The rules that separate a publishable article from one to reject. The Writer and the Director share them.
prompts.palette.hint: Two colours, for the duotone finish in the illustration draw. In English, as words and not hex: e.g. «amber and deep-blue».
prompts.palette.label: House palette
prompts.portadas.desc: What shows up in an article's image. The engine draws the medium (photo, illustration, print) per article; here you decide WHAT to show and under which rules.
prompts.redes.desc: Which handle signs them, how they sound and what the Social Studio pieces look like: carousels, stories and clips. The colours and the logo the cards are DRAWN with are chosen under Site and integrations → Visual identity: they are not text and no agent reads them.
prompts.socialVoice.hint: What kind of organisation this is, how it sounds and what is NEVER done. It is an instruction, so it goes in English; the text that gets published comes out in the site's language.
prompts.socialVoice.label: Social voice and hard rules
prompts.sources.hint: Bodies and publications that CAN be named without it counting as reproducing a rival outlet. Proper nouns go exactly as they are spelled.
prompts.sources.label: Citable official sources
prompts.subtitulo: What turns the engine into THIS portal: the agents read it on every run. Each field states which language it takes — instructions for the model go in English, and the language of what gets published is decided by «Writing language». An empty field uses the engine's default, and «Restore» goes back to that neutral value, NOT to the text your project started with.
prompts.themeGuide.hint: THEME → SCENES. Each category offers four variants so two similar articles do not end up with the same cover.
prompts.themeGuide.label: Scene catalogue
prompts.traduccion.desc: Only used if automatic translation is switched on, under Site and integrations.
prompts.traducir.nota: We translate it and show it to you to review: what gets sent to the model is the final text, not this draft.
prompts.translationLanguage.hint: The language each article is translated into. The source is the writing language.
prompts.translationLanguage.label: Target language
prompts.videoDefault.hint: The b-roll Social Studio proposes when none is written.
prompts.videoDefault.label: Default clip
prompts.videoStyle.hint: Appended to EVERY clip. Atmosphere, palette and prohibitions go here (no text, no logos).
prompts.videoStyle.label: Video style
prompts.writingLanguage.hint: The language the agents write articles, captions and cards in.
prompts.writingLanguage.label: Writing language
rss.borrar.pregunta: Delete the feed «{nombre}»? This cannot be undone.
rss.check.resumen: {total} items in total · {frescos} from {dias, plural, one {the last 24h} other {the last # days}}
rss.desc.frescos: {n} in {dias, plural, one {the last 24h} other {the last # days}}
rss.desc.hint: A topic in one or two words, or the domain of an outlet you already know. Every result is downloaded and parsed before it is shown, so it takes a few seconds.
rss.desc.label: What you are looking for
rss.desc.sinResultados: No live source found for “{query}”. Try a broader term —the directories search literally and choke on phrases—, drop the language filter, or paste the outlet's domain directly.
rss.idioma.label: Language
rss.pais.hint: Pick a country and the search looks at which outlets there are covering the topic, then finds their own RSS. With no country it only searches Feedly's catalogue, which has almost no Latin American outlets.
rss.pais.label: Country
rss.resumenFuentes: {n, plural, one {# source} other {# sources}} · {activas} enabled
rss.subtitulo: Manage the news sources that feed the agents' daily knowledge base.
rss.url.hint: Public URL of the RSS feed (XML format).
rss.url.label: Feed URL
rss.vacio: No feeds configured yet. Search for sources by topic to get started.
setup.completo: Nothing missing. The agents can write and publish.
ss.clipFondo.hint: Describe the b-roll (no text). The brand style is appended.
ss.configura.desc: Pick a source, a format and the models. You see the cost plan before anything runs, and an editable preview afterwards.
ss.deck.ayuda: Edit the texts and refresh the preview (free, no AI call). When it looks right: download the cards or save them to the article.
ss.deck.caption: Caption for the Instagram feed (with hashtags).
ss.deck.descargar.desc: downloads the full-resolution images to your computer (and copies the caption) — ready to post to Instagram by hand.
ss.deck.guardar.descMedios: uploads them to the Media Library. It does not post to Instagram.
ss.deck.guardar.descNota: uploads them to the Media Library and attaches them to the article (Social Cards field + caption). It does not post to Instagram.
ss.deck.necesitaNota: «Save to the article» needs an article picked as the source — but «Download the cards» works either way.
ss.deck.ok.guardado: Carousel saved to the article and to Media.
ss.deck.permiso: . If the browser asks, allow «download multiple files».
ss.err.config: Could not load the Studio configuration.
ss.err.expiro: The job expired (the server restarted). The backgrounds it generated are in AI Backgrounds.
ss.fondoIA.hint: Which model generates the AI background (if you do not pick an existing one).
ss.fondoPortada.hint: With no background chosen, one is generated with AI and kept in AI Backgrounds to reuse.
ss.fondos.vacioDesc: Once you generate content with AI, the backgrounds are kept here to reuse for free.
ss.generadaSuelta: Generated from your own prompt: it is in Media, ready to use wherever you like.
ss.historia.nota: A story can be a static card or a video (the card is laid over a clip).
ss.imagenEnMedios: The image is already in Media (AI Backgrounds folder).
ss.modeloVideo.hint: Price per second of generated video.
ss.ok.portada: Cover applied to the article (without touching the publication date).
ss.overlay.nota: The card (template chosen above) is composed from the source and laid over the clip. You edit the texts afterwards.
ss.planCostos.nota: Estimated costs; the real price depends on the provider. Nothing runs until you press Generate.
ss.portadaEsPrompt: For a cover, this text IS the image prompt.
ss.reel.ayuda: Edit the overlay texts and recompose: it reuses the clip already generated, so it does not spend AI again (only ffmpeg).
ss.reel.err: Error saving the reel. Try recomposing it (that is free).
ss.reel.nota: The clip is saved in the AI Backgrounds folder — recomposing or regenerating overlays never pays for AI again.
ss.reelDeshabilitado: Reel disabled: ffmpeg is missing on the server (apt/brew install ffmpeg, or the FFMPEG_PATH env var).
ss.story.ayuda: Edit the card texts and recompose: it reuses the clip already generated, so it does not spend AI again (only ffmpeg).
ss.story.err: Error saving. Try recomposing (that is free).
ss.story.nota: The clip is in AI Backgrounds — recomposing never pays for AI again.
